seen_animation: Still frames only. A two-rail track with short cross-ties (black) rises from the lower left to a peak near the top centre, where two straight legs drop down to the right. A short train of four or five small rectangular cars with tick marks on top sits on the incline. A grey cloud sits at upper right and a grey tower stands on the peak. Frames 1-2: the peak is near the top edge at about x=190 and the tower is cut off by the frame edge; the train is in the middle of the incline. Frames 3-9: the whole drawing moves down and to the left in steady steps, as if the view tilts up, and the tower's flat cap comes fully into view (frame 4 onward). The train moves up the incline relative to the track. Frames 9-16: the view settles with the peak at about x=120, y=95; the train reaches the area just below the peak around frame 12 and then advances very little through frame 16.
seen_film: A black-and-white shot of a wooden roller coaster lift hill rising from lower left to a summit, with a tall tower structure on top and large curved track sections to the right. A train of cars carrying riders climbs the lift hill. Frames 1-3: the summit is at the top edge and the tower is cut off. Frames 4-9: the camera tilts up and pans slightly so the structure moves down and left, and the tower with its flat cap comes fully into view. Frames 9-16: the framing is nearly steady; the train keeps climbing and its lead car arrives at the summit under the tower by frame 16.
named_subject: A roller coaster lift hill (two-rail track with ties) with a small train of cars climbing it.
evidence: Frames 1-2 in both: peak at the top edge, tower cut off, train mid-incline.
